batch_script:
#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --job-name=623-matching
#SBATCH --partition=cpu
#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=8
#SBATCH --mem=16G
#SBATCH --time=00:30:00
#SBATCH --output=/home/aamador/pyrite-issue623/issue623-matching-%j.log
set -eu
arm=${1:?arm required}
tier=${2:?tier required}
cells=2; ppc=16; depth=10000; cuts=(--cut-eV 95 --cut-eV 178)
case "$arm" in
  cuts) depth=20000; cuts=(--cut-eV 8.19 --cut-eV 50 --cut-eV 95 --cut-eV 178) ;;
  grid) ppc=24 ;;
  supercell) cells=3 ;;
  *) exit 2 ;;
esac
case "$tier" in
  pilot) chunks=2; electrons=8 ;;
  main) chunks=8; electrons=32; [ "$arm" = cuts ] && chunks=32 ;;
  *) exit 2 ;;
esac
cd /home/aamador/pyrite-issue623
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS=1
export PYRITE_MC_BACKEND=cpu
study_dir=pyrite-output/research/issue623/matching-20261021/$arm-$tier
mkdir -p "$study_dir"
test ! -e "$study_dir/result.json"
exec 9<.pyrite-sync.lock
flock -s 9
cp .pyrite-sync "$study_dir/code-identity.txt"
cp "$0" "$study_dir/run.sh"
echo "$arm $tier" > "$study_dir/args.txt"
sha256sum checks/axial_mcwf_return_flux.py src/pyrite/montecarlo/channeling/axial_projection.py > "$study_dir/script-sha256.txt"
/home/aamador/.local/bin/uv run --no-sync --no-default-groups python -c \
  'import sys,numpy,scipy; print(sys.version); print("numpy",numpy.__version__); print("scipy",scipy.__version__)' > "$study_dir/environment.txt"
/usr/bin/time -v -o "$study_dir/resources.txt" \
  /home/aamador/.local/bin/uv run --no-sync --no-default-groups python checks/axial_mcwf_return_flux.py \
  --projected-no-jump "${cuts[@]}" --cells "$cells" --points-per-cell "$ppc" \
  --workers "$SLURM_CPUS_PER_TASK" --chunks "$chunks" --electrons-per-chunk "$electrons" \
  --depth-max-ang "$depth" --depth-step-ang 1000 --step-ang 10 \
  --out "$study_dir/result.json"
method: Deficit D=1-sum X/sum X_ref per depth (pooled over seed chunks); delete-one-seed-chunk jackknife SEM. Cut-to-cut and projected-minus-hook differences recompute both ratios with the shared matrix reference per deleted chunk. Grid/supercell vs control (1649, seeds 0-7) delete the same seed from both arms; their streams diverge, so these pairs are weakly correlated. SEMs are not confidence bounds.
resource_caveat: GNU time MaxRSS covers the parent process, not forkserver workers or allocation peak.
submission: pilots: sbatch run-matching.sh ARM pilot (8 CPU, 16G, 30 min); main: cuts 16 CPU/20G, grid 8 CPU/36G pinned DESKTOP-QNIHO3D, supercell 12 CPU/22G; 60 min limits
